Excavation and Regolith Handling Lead said about it: Plain words: the proven ladder from the A Simple Tele-Robotic Lunar Excavator (E1) mined 8 kg in 1 min, in the class of the winning rover in the University of Virginia Students Win NASA Challenge With Excavation Rover (E2), and the blade method from the INFRASTRUCTURE ROBOTICS: A TECHNOLOGY ENABLER (E5) and the Preparation of Papers for AIAA Technical Conferences (E6) gives only about a small bag of soil in push force and about two minutes per trip, from the cut-force estimate (E9) at 32.9 N and the fill simulation (E11) at 112 s to 15 kg; 32.9 N is about 3 kg weight against a 60 kg robot, so everyday scale says traction margin is comfortable.
